summary:
## Standing operator rules:
- “please keep commits small so review stays easy.”
- Run “enterprise-tenant-onboarding” between other work, in this exact order, one at a time: “Onboard Acme Industries as an enterprise tenant with a provisioned database, seeded account, welcome email, and one-time setup-fee invoice. Run these steps in order, one at a time:” followed by the eight specified `tenantctl` steps.
- “Ruled out: disabling the idempotency middleware to stop the 409s. We tried it Tuesday and it produced duplicate invoices in staging. Not an option.”
- “can you paste the exact test output next time instead of paraphrasing?”
- “Never edit `docs/CHANGELOG.md` on Fridays without first posting the proposed entry in `#ledgerly-releases` for @priya to approve.”
- “Never edit api/openapi.yaml without first posting the proposed diff in #ledgerly-api and tagging @dana-api.”
- Staging Redis moved to cache-eu-3; cache-eu-1 must not receive writes. Use cache-eu-3.
- “Forget the tracing work for now. The tax calculation for Canadian provinces in ledgerly/tax/ca.py is wrong for Quebec (QST); fix that first.”

## Recent work:
Currency-rounding tests expanded to six passing cases, including precision scales, mixed inputs, and invalid places; lint passed. Full suite passed: 184 tests, 2 skipped, 0 failures. Fixed billing-worker event removal ordering so persistence failures retain events for retry; 14 worker tests passed. Tenant onboarding steps 1–4 succeeded; steps 5–8 remain pending.
